title: Stop wavering where mercy already holds you
summary: The shabad begins with mercy before it confronts fear. Wavering loses authority when the heart hears, again and again, that the Lord Master is merciful.
takeaway: Let mercy speak before the disaster story gathers force.
lifeApplication: When the disaster story starts to grow, repeat the mercy named in the first lines before you rehearse outcomes. Let the heart stand under that word long enough to stop shaking alone.

source.shortMeaning: Mercy is named before fear is answered, so the wavering mind hears who is holding it.
source.lifeApplication: When you start wavering, let mercy speak before the disaster story grows.
